en: Color postcard showing a snowy winter scene at a mountain resort: a stone-and-wood alpine hotel with steep roof, balconies and tall fir trees. People and a 1970s Eastern Bloc car appear in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian text and a 40 B 'posta română' stamp (red poppies, dated 1975) with Brașov postmarks and a printed caption identifying Poiana Brașov and the hotel.
